biotools.summary: SEQSIM is a sequence comparison tool leveraging an optimized Needleman-Wunsch algorithm for high-speed comparisons of promoter regions. It facilitates genome-wide analysis and identification of homology clusters, revealing potential co-regulatory networks and conserved motifs.
